items.text: Vercel is making its Sandbox Egress Firewall free on every plan, citing security research showing untrusted agent-written code needs network-level containment, not just compute isolation.
items.text_zh: Vercel 宣布 Sandbox 出站流量防火墙在所有套餐中免费开放，理由是近期安全研究表明，运行不可信的 Agent 生成代码不能只靠算力隔离，还需要网络层管控。

items.text: MiniMax highlighted a community-built inference engine that runs its open-weights H3 model natively on Mac computers, days after the release.
items.text_zh: MiniMax 转发展示了一位顶级开发者为 Mac 电脑编写的 H3 推理引擎，称开放权重意味着任何人都能把 H3 跑在任意硬件上。

items.text: Runway added Ideogram's P-Image model to its platform, generating images from prompts in as little as 0.6 seconds across four quality modes.
items.text_zh: Runway 上线 Ideogram 的 P-Image 模型，最快 0.6 秒即可从提示词出图，并提供四档质量模式在速度与细节之间取舍。

items.text: Meshy released Meshy 7, focused on narrowing the alignment gap between an input image and the generated 3D model.
items.text_zh: Meshy 发布 Meshy 7，重点收窄输入图像与生成 3D 模型之间的「对齐差距」，让成品更贴合参考图。

items.text: Recraft showed V4.1 holding one character and art style across four different scenes, varying hair, lighting and expression while keeping everything else fixed.
items.text_zh: Recraft 展示 V4.1 的风格一致性：同一角色、同一风格跨四个场景生成，仅发型、光照与表情变化，其余元素保持锁定。

items.text: ElevenLabs is partnering with Deutsche Telekom to embed its AI voice models network-side, powering a call assistant that works on any phone able to make calls.
items.text_zh: ElevenLabs 宣布与德国电信合作，将 AI 语音技术嵌入其网络侧，使 AI 通话助手可在任何能打电话的手机上使用，并已用于客服业务。

items.text: NVIDIA released Magpie TTS Multilingual, a 364M-parameter open-weights speech model covering 12 languages with 32ms time-to-first-audio on B200.
items.text_zh: 英伟达发布 Magpie TTS Multilingual，3.64 亿参数开放权重语音合成模型，支持 12 种语言，在 B200 上单流首字音延迟仅 32 毫秒。

items.text: Microsoft shipped Agent Framework Harness and Foundry Hosted Agents to production, bundling tool approval, context compression, file memory and OpenTelemetry on by default.
items.text_zh: 微软正式发布 Agent Framework Harness 与 Foundry Hosted Agents，内置工具审批、上下文压缩、文件记忆与 OpenTelemetry 遥测并默认开启，按用量计费托管运行。

items.text: Fireworks AI released a Training Skill that lets coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Cursor configure and launch fine-tuning jobs from one install line.
items.text_zh: Fireworks AI 推出 Training Skill，一行命令安装后，Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等编程 Agent 即可直接配置并启动其训练任务。

items.text: Sakana AI said it is expanding its Recursive Self-Improvement Lab into physical AI, building world models aimed at robotics.
items.text_zh: Sakana AI 宣布将其递归自我改进（RSI）实验室扩展到物理 AI 方向，着手构建面向机器人的世界模型。

items.text: Hugging Face and EleutherAI's FineBooks benchmarked 14 OCR models on historical pages, showing above 97% character accuracy for under $2 per thousand pages.
items.text_zh: Hugging Face 与 EleutherAI 推出 FineBooks：在历史书页上评测 14 个开源 OCR 模型，最佳者字符准确率超 97%，每千页成本不到 2 美元，计划重跑 20 万份公共领域文献。

items.text: Arena said the proprietary-versus-open-source performance gap has reached its narrowest point yet, citing frontier margins in Code Arena's WebDev leaderboard.
items.text_zh: Arena 表示闭源与开源模型的性能差距已缩至历史最窄，并以 Code Arena WebDev 榜单上的前沿分差作为依据。

items.text: ChatGPT deepened its Yelp integration in the US and Canada, letting users book restaurant tables directly inside a conversation.
items.text_zh: ChatGPT 在美加地区进一步接入点评平台 Yelp，用户可在对话过程中直接完成餐厅订座。

items.text: Discovered Materials raised a $9M seed led by Lightspeed India to run agent swarms on Anthropic models plus physics simulation, hunting cooler semiconductor materials.
items.text_zh: Discovered Materials 完成 900 万美元种子轮，由 Lightspeed India 领投，Peak XV 及 Paul Graham 等参投；公司用 Anthropic 模型驱动的 Agent 集群配合物理仿真，寻找更散热的芯片材料。

items.text: Nvidia will guarantee up to 25% of residual chip value in AI data-center projects, unlocking over $500 billion of third-party capital from Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone and KKR.
items.text_zh: 英伟达联手阿波罗、贝莱德、黑石、布鲁克菲尔德、高盛与 KKR，为 AI 数据中心项目中最高 25% 的芯片残值提供担保，以此撬动逾 5000 亿美元第三方资金。

items.text: Google co-founder Sergey Brin has re-immersed himself in Gemini strategy, the FT reports, while SemiAnalysis says Gemini 3.5 Pro was quietly cancelled after its May I/O preview.
items.text_zh: 《金融时报》称谷歌联合创始人布林已深度回归 Gemini 战略决策；SemiAnalysis 则透露，5 月 I/O 上宣称「下个月见」的 Gemini 3.5 Pro 已被悄悄取消。

items.text: OpenAI completed a $7 billion tender offer letting employees sell shares at the same $852 billion valuation as its March round, signaling no imminent IPO.
items.text_zh: OpenAI 完成 70 亿美元员工股份回购，估值与 3 月融资时持平于 8520 亿美元，被视为 IPO 短期内不会推进的信号。

items.text: webAI released TwIL-LM, 1.7B and 3B autoformalization models that turn English into first-order logic at 32.9 answers per second versus 4.2 for gpt-oss-120b.
items.text_zh: webAI 发布 TwIL-LM 系列：1.7B 与 3B 形式逻辑模型，可将英文自动转为一阶逻辑，吞吐达每秒 32.9 条答案，而 gpt-oss-120b 仅 4.2 条，权重目前仅限非商业使用。

items.text: LangAlpha open-sourced a "financial Agent OS" that drives investment-research workflows from natural language, with code execution, persistent workspaces and support for Claude, DeepSeek, GLM and Kimi.
items.text_zh: LangAlpha 开源「金融 Agent OS」，用自然语言驱动投研工作流，内置代码执行、可持续复用的工作区与审计留痕，并支持 Claude、OpenAI、DeepSeek、GLM、Kimi 等多家模型。

items.text: DORA published seven AI-assisted development team archetypes and seven enabling capabilities, noting individual efficiency rose with AI adoption while software delivery stability fell.
items.text_zh: DORA 发布 AI 辅助研发的七类团队画像与七项关键能力，并指出一个悖论：AI 使用率提升带来个人效率与代码质量改善，交付稳定性却在下降。

items.text: Five Chinese universities launched TriWorldBench, the first robot three-view world-model leaderboard, scoring 19 metrics across six dimensions with WoVR_Plus leading week one.
items.text_zh: 北大、清华、北航、上交与中科大联合发布首个机器人三视角世界模型评测榜 TriWorldBench，覆盖六大维度 19 项指标，首期榜首为中科院自动化所的 WoVR_Plus。

items.text: Artificial Analysis said output speed for one identical model can vary more than 15x across inference providers, and published a breakdown of why those gaps exist.
items.text_zh: Artificial Analysis 指出，同一个模型在不同推理服务商处的输出速度差距可超过 15 倍，并撰文拆解造成这种差距的原因及其实际影响。

items.text: Sakana AI opened full-time and internship hiring for frontier researchers and engineers to build its next generation of recursive self-improvement systems.
items.text_zh: Sakana AI 开启招聘，为下一代递归自我改进（RSI）系统招募前沿研究员与工程师，全职岗位与实习岗位同步开放。

items.text: MarkTechPost published a walkthrough for wiring MiniMax-H3 into ComfyUI API nodes as one multimodal pipeline that generates video and matching audio together.
items.text_zh: MarkTechPost 发布教程，演示如何用 ComfyUI 的 API 节点把 MiniMax-H3 接成一条多模态流水线，一次生成视频并配上匹配音频。

items.text: PixVerse opened the Canvas project behind its live-action Barbie-inspired giantess short, exposing scale beats, dialogue timing, lip sync and camera grammar for remixing.
items.text_zh: PixVerse 公开其真人风格「芭比巨人少女」短片的 Canvas 工程文件，展示尺度节奏、台词时序、锁定唇形与运镜语法，供用户直接二次创作。

items.text: Guide Labs' Steerling-8B shows interpretability scaling with capability, matching peer models while using 2-16x less compute and allowing concept steering without retraining.
items.text_zh: Guide Labs 论文提出 Steerling-8B：在跨三个数量级算力的训练中内建可解释性，性能对标同级模型却少用 2–16 倍算力，并支持免重训的概念归因与引导干预。

items.text: A new study found Claude models write SOC 2-compliant code only 47-88% of the time unprompted—including a remote-code-execution debugger—but 86-100% once SOC 2 is mentioned.
items.text_zh: 一项研究评测 Claude Fable 5、Opus 4.8 与 Opus 5 的代码合规性：无安全提示时 SOC 2 达标率仅 47%–88%，还出现可远程执行代码的调试器；只需提一句 SOC 2，达标率升至 86%–100%。

items.text: Search-G1 trains search agents with representation-based intrinsic rewards that judge when retrieval is actually needed, yielding shorter trajectories at competitive QA accuracy.
items.text_zh: Search-G1 提出基于表征的内在奖励，让搜索型 Agent 自行判断何时真正需要检索，在多个问答基准上以更短的轨迹保持相当准确率。
